title: Most-cited OSHA standards: architectural, engineering and related services (NAICS 5413)
seoTitle: Engineering safety: OSHA citations in NAICS 5413
description: OSHA citations in architectural, engineering and related services (NAICS 5413), FY2022–FY2026: respiratory protection and hazard communication lead.
opening: In architectural, engineering, and related services (NAICS 5413), OSHA cited 1910.134, respiratory protection, most often in FY2022–FY2026, with 93 citations, ahead of 1910.1200 hazard communication (88) and 1910.1450 on hazardous chemicals in laboratories (61).
patternsSummary: Chemical and airborne exposure standards dominate the top of the NAICS 5413 list: respiratory protection (1910.134, 93 citations), hazard communication (1910.1200, 88), hazardous chemicals in laboratories (1910.1450, 61), respirable crystalline silica (1926.1153, 35) and methylene chloride (1910.1052, 22). Personal protective equipment general requirements (1910.132, 45) and lockout/tagout (1910.147, 36) come next, and two Subpart S electrical standards appear, 1910.305 on wiring methods (28) and 1910.303 (24). Over FY2022–FY2026 OSHA recorded 1,343 inspections and 915 citations in this code, and 42 standards were cited 5 or more times.
penaltiesSummary: Across the 534 citations with a recorded penalty, the median was $4,684, and the middle half fell between $2,486 and $8,287. Serious citations made up 66% of the total, other-than-serious 33%, and willful and repeat citations 1% each.

standardNotes.note: Respiratory protection for general industry, in Subpart I, Personal Protective Equipment. Cited 93 times, more than any other standard in this code.
Hazard communication, a Subpart Z standard on toxic and hazardous substances. Second on the list with 88 citations.
Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories, also in Subpart Z. Third, with 61 citations.
General requirements of Subpart I, the personal protective equipment subpart. 45 citations.
The control of hazardous energy (lockout/tagout), in Subpart J, General Environmental Controls. 36 citations.
Respirable crystalline silica in construction (Part 1926, Subpart Z). The highest-ranked construction standard here, with 35 citations.
Wiring methods, components, and equipment for general use, in Subpart S, Electrical. 28 citations.
General requirements for walking-working surfaces, in Subpart D, Walking-Working Surfaces. 26 citations.
